en.title: Build an AI Music Cue Sheet for a Spoken-Word Poetry Set
en.description: A practical way to give a poetry reading shape without covering the language, breath, or silence that makes it land.
body: A spoken-word set can lose its center when music tries to rescue every quiet second. A pulse that is compelling by itself can flatten a line break, hide a consonant, or tell the audience how to feel before the poem has earned it. The useful question is not “what track fits this poem?” but “where does sound help the listener stay with the words?”

## What is EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ai-music-generator) is a platform for creating music drafts from prompts, lyrics, and style direction. For a reading, it can help you audition spare instrumental textures; the poet, performers, venue team, and sound engineer still make the final artistic and technical decisions. The [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/music-style-generator) can turn a loose atmosphere note into a testable brief, and the [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/tools/audio-converter) can prepare a review file.

## Start with a word-and-breath map
Print the set list and mark three things: lines that need clean silence, places where a small entrance can reset attention, and applause or movement transitions. Names, direct quotations, fast lists, multilingual passages, and the final line of a poem usually belong in the first group. W3C guidance on foreground speech offers a sensible principle: background sound should not make spoken material harder to distinguish. Do not assume a microphone or captions solves a cluttered mix.

## Prompt for restraint
Try: `sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech.` Make a second draft by changing only one element, such as removing percussion. Avoid named artists and familiar-song references. A prompt should describe pace, density, instruments, and boundaries rather than imitate a recognizable voice.

## Assign three cue types
Use a five-second arrival cue before the first poem, a very low or silent floor beneath text-heavy passages, and a short release cue after a complete poem—not after every stanza. Rehearse with the actual microphone, room, and speaker position. Then listen from the back of the room. If you lose a word, the music is not “atmosphere”; it is interference.

## Ideas to use tonight
- Write SILENCE beside every line that carries the poem’s turn or ending.
- Keep one cue longer than needed so the engineer has a clean fade.
- Make a second version with one less instrument, not one more.
- Hand over timestamps, start/stop signals, and the person allowed to call changes.

## FAQ
### Should every poem have music?
No. Contrast makes the few cues that remain more meaningful.
### Can a cue play under a fast poem?
Usually only if the words stay effortlessly clear; test the actual delivery.
### How loud should it be?
There is no universal setting. Mix against the live voice in the venue, with language first.
### Does AI music solve rights or venue requirements?
No. Confirm the applicable permissions, contracts, and venue rules with the responsible people.

de.title: Eine AI-Music-Cue-Sheet fuer eine Spoken-Word-Lesung erstellen
de.description: Ein praktischer Ablauf, der einer Lesung Form gibt, ohne Sprache, Atem oder Stille zu verdecken.
body: Eine Spoken-Word-Lesung verliert ihr Zentrum, wenn Musik jede Pause retten will. Ein allein spannender Puls kann einen Zeilenbruch glatten, einen Konsonanten verdecken oder Gefuehle vorwegnehmen. Die bessere Frage lautet: Wo hilft Klang dem Publikum, bei den Worten zu bleiben?

## Was ist EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/de/ai-music-generator) ist eine Plattform fuer Musikentwuerfe aus Prompts, Lyrics und Stilrichtung. Fuer eine Lesung lassen sich sparsame Instrumentaltexturen testen; Poet, Auftretende, Venue-Team und Tonperson treffen weiter die finalen Entscheidungen. Der [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/music-style-generator) macht aus einer Stimmungsnotiz einen Brief, der [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/audio-converter) eine Review-Datei.

## Wort- und Atemkarte zuerst
Markiere saubere Stille, kleine Einstiege und Uebergaenge fuer Applaus oder Bewegung. Namen, direkte Zitate, schnelle Listen, mehrsprachige Passagen und letzte Zeilen gehoeren oft zur Stille. Hintergrund darf Sprache nicht schwerer verstaendlich machen; Mikrofon und Captions ersetzen keinen klaren Mix.

## Zurueckhaltend prompten
Versuche: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Erstelle eine zweite Fassung mit nur einer Aenderung, etwa ohne Percussion. Vermeide Kuenstlernamen.

## Drei Cue-Typen
Nutze fuenf Sekunden Ankunft vor dem ersten Gedicht, sehr leisen oder keinen Boden unter textreichen Stellen und einen kurzen Release nach einem ganzen Gedicht. Probe mit echtem Mikrofon und Raum. Geht hinten im Raum ein Wort verloren, ist die Musik Stoerung.

## Heute nutzbar
- Schreibe STILLE neben Wendung und Ende jedes Gedichts.
- Halte einen Cue laenger fuer einen sauberen Fade.
- Mache eine Fassung mit einem Instrument weniger.
- Gib Zeitstempel, Start/Stop-Signale und verantwortliche Person weiter.

## FAQ
### Braucht jedes Gedicht Musik?
Nein. Kontrast macht einzelne Cues bedeutender.
### Unter einem schnellen Gedicht?
Nur wenn Worte muehelos klar bleiben.
### Wie laut?
Mische gegen die Live-Stimme im Raum.
### Loest AI-Music Rechte oder Venue-Regeln?
Nein, klaere Anforderungen mit Verantwortlichen.

es.title: Crea una cue sheet de musica con IA para poesia hablada
es.description: Un flujo practico para dar forma a una lectura sin tapar lenguaje, respiracion ni silencio.
body: Una lectura de poesia hablada pierde su centro cuando la musica intenta salvar cada pausa. Un pulso atractivo por si solo puede aplanar un corte de verso, ocultar una consonante o dictar una emocion antes de que el poema la gane. La pregunta util es donde ayuda el sonido a seguir las palabras.

## Que es EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/es/ai-music-generator) es una plataforma para crear borradores musicales desde prompts, lyrics y direccion de estilo. Para una lectura permite probar texturas instrumentales escasas; poeta, interpretes, venue y tecnico de sonido siguen tomando las decisiones finales. El [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/music-style-generator) convierte una nota de ambiente en brief y [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/audio-converter) prepara una copia de revision.

## Empieza con mapa de palabras y respiracion
Marca silencio limpio, entradas pequenas y transiciones de aplauso o movimiento. Nombres, citas directas, listas rapidas, pasajes multilingues y ultima linea suelen ir en silencio. El fondo no debe volver la voz menos distinguible; microfono y captions no sustituyen mezcla clara.

## Prompt con contencion
Prueba: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Crea otra version cambiando solo la percusion. Evita nombres de artistas.

## Tres tipos de cue
Usa cinco segundos de llegada antes del primer poema, suelo muy bajo o silencio bajo pasajes densos, y un release breve tras un poema completo. Ensaya con microfono y sala reales. Si desde el fondo se pierde una palabra, la musica interfiere.

## Ideas para hoy
- Escribe SILENCIO junto al giro y final de cada poema.
- Deja un cue mas largo para un fade limpio.
- Haz una version con un instrumento menos.
- Entrega timestamps, senales y responsable de cambios.

## FAQ
### Cada poema necesita musica?
No. El contraste da sentido a pocos cues.
### Debajo de poema rapido?
Solo si las palabras siguen claras.
### Que volumen?
Mezcla con la voz real en la sala.
### Resuelve IA derechos o reglas del venue?
No; confirma requisitos responsables.

fr.title: Creer une cue sheet de musique IA pour une scene de poesie parlee
fr.description: Un flux pratique pour donner une forme a une lecture sans couvrir les mots, le souffle ou le silence.
body: Une scene de poesie parlee perd son centre quand la musique veut sauver chaque pause. Un pulse interessant seul peut aplatir un vers, cacher une consonne ou imposer une emotion avant que le poeme la merite. La bonne question est: ou le son aide-t-il le public a rester avec les mots?

## Qu est-ce que EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/fr/ai-music-generator) est une plateforme de brouillons musicaux depuis prompts, lyrics et direction de style. Pour une lecture, elle permet d essayer des textures instrumentales sobres; poete, interpretes, equipe du lieu et ingenieur son gardent la decision finale. Le [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/fr/tools/music-style-generator) transforme une note d ambiance en brief, et [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/fr/tools/audio-converter) prepare une copie de revue.

## Carte des mots et du souffle
Marque le silence net, les petites entrees et les transitions d applaudissements. Noms, citations, listes rapides, passages multilingues et derniere ligne demandent souvent le silence. Le fond ne doit pas rendre la parole moins distincte; micro et captions ne remplacent pas un mix clair.

## Un prompt retenu
Essaie: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Fais une version avec seulement la percussion en moins. Evite les noms d artistes.

## Trois types de cue
Place cinq secondes d arrivee avant le premier poeme, un fond tres bas ou le silence sous le texte dense, et un bref release apres un poeme entier. Repete avec le vrai micro et la salle. Si un mot se perd au fond, la musique interfere.

## Idees pour ce soir
- Ecris SILENCE pres du tournant et de la fin.
- Garde un cue plus long pour un fade net.
- Fais une version avec un instrument de moins.
- Partage timestamps, signaux et responsable des changements.

## FAQ
### Chaque poeme demande-t-il de la musique?
Non. Le contraste rend les rares cues plus forts.
### Sous un poeme rapide?
Seulement si les mots restent clairs.
### Quel volume?
Mixez contre la voix live.
### L IA regle-t-elle droits et regles du lieu?
Non; confirmez-les avec les responsables.

it.title: Crea una cue sheet di musica AI per una lettura di poesia spoken word
it.description: Un flusso pratico per dare forma alla lettura senza coprire parole, respiro o silenzio.
body: Una lettura spoken word perde il centro quando la musica vuole salvare ogni pausa. Un pulse interessante da solo puo appiattire un verso, nascondere una consonante o imporre un emozione prima che la poesia la meriti. La domanda utile e dove il suono aiuta ad ascoltare le parole.

## Che cos e EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/it/ai-music-generator) e una piattaforma per bozze musicali da prompts, lyrics e direzione di stile. Per una lettura permette di provare texture instrumentali sobrie; poeta, performer, team del luogo e tecnico del suono decidono il finale. Il [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/music-style-generator) trasforma una nota in brief e [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/audio-converter) prepara una copia di review.

## Mappa parole e respiro
Segna silenzio pulito, piccoli ingressi e transizioni per applauso o movimento. Nomi, citazioni, liste veloci, passaggi multilingui e ultima riga spesso richiedono silenzio. Il fondo non deve rendere meno distinta la voce; microfono e captions non sostituiscono un mix chiaro.

## Prompt misurato
Prova: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Fai una seconda versione togliendo solo la percussione. Evita nomi di artisti.

## Tre cue
Usa cinque secondi di arrivo prima della prima poesia, fondo bassissimo o silenzio sotto testo denso, e breve release dopo una poesia completa. Prova con microfono e sala reali. Se una parola si perde in fondo, la musica interferisce.

## Idee per stasera
- Scrivi SILENZIO vicino a svolta e finale.
- Tieni un cue piu lungo per fade pulito.
- Fai una versione con uno strumento in meno.
- Consegna timestamps, segnali e responsabile cambi.

## FAQ
### Ogni poesia richiede musica?
No. Il contrasto rende importanti pochi cue.
### Sotto poesia veloce?
Solo se le parole restano chiare.
### Quanto forte?
Mixa contro voce live.
### AI risolve diritti o regole del luogo?
No, conferma con responsabili.

pt.title: Crie uma cue sheet de musica com IA para poesia falada
pt.description: Um fluxo pratico para dar forma a leitura sem cobrir palavras, respiracao ou silencio.
body: Uma leitura de poesia falada perde o centro quando a musica tenta salvar cada pausa. Um pulso interessante sozinho pode achatar uma quebra de verso, esconder uma consoante ou impor emocao antes de o poema merecer. A pergunta util e onde o som ajuda o publico a acompanhar as palavras.

## O que e EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/pt/ai-music-generator) e uma plataforma para rascunhos musicais com prompts, lyrics e direcao de estilo. Para leitura, permite testar texturas instrumentais contidas; poeta, performers, equipe do local e tecnico de som decidem o final. O [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/music-style-generator) transforma nota de atmosfera em brief e o [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/audio-converter) prepara copia de revisao.

## Mapa de palavras e respiracao
Marque silencio limpo, entradas pequenas e transicoes de aplauso. Nomes, citacoes, listas rapidas, trechos multilingues e ultima linha muitas vezes precisam de silencio. O fundo nao pode tornar fala menos distinta; microfone e captions nao substituem mix claro.

## Prompt contido
Tente: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Faca outra versao mudando apenas a percussao. Evite nomes de artistas.

## Tres cue types
Use cinco segundos de chegada, fundo muito baixo ou silencio sob texto denso, e release curto apos poema inteiro. Ensaie com microfone e sala reais. Se uma palavra some ao fundo, a musica interfere.

## Ideias para hoje
- Escreva SILENCIO ao lado da virada e final.
- Deixe cue mais longo para fade limpo.
- Faca versao com um instrumento a menos.
- Passe timestamps, sinais e responsavel pelos cambios.

## FAQ
### Todo poema precisa de musica?
Nao. Contraste da sentido aos poucos cues.
### Sob poema rapido?
So se palavras ficam claras.
### Qual volume?
Misture com voz ao vivo.
### IA resolve direitos ou regras do local?
Nao; confirme com responsaveis.

ru.title: Как сделать AI music cue sheet для вечера spoken-word poetry
ru.description: Практичный подход: придать чтению форму, не закрывая слова, дыхание и тишину.
body: Вечер spoken-word poetry теряет центр, когда музыка пытается заполнить каждую паузу. Интересный сам по себе pulse может сгладить перенос строки, скрыть согласную или навязать эмоцию раньше стихотворения. Полезный вопрос: где звук помогает слушателю оставаться со словами?

## Что такое EasyMusic.AI?
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ru/ai-music-generator) — платформа для music drafts из prompts, lyrics и style direction. На чтении она помогает проверить редкие instrumental textures; poet, performers, venue team и sound engineer все равно принимают финальные решения. [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/music-style-generator) превращает заметку в brief, а [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/audio-converter) готовит review copy.

## Карта слов и дыхания
Отметьте чистую тишину, небольшие вступления и переходы для аплодисментов. Имена, цитаты, быстрые списки, многоязычные фрагменты и последняя строка обычно требуют тишины. Фон не должен делать speech менее различимой; микрофон и captions не заменяют чистый mix.

## Сдержанный prompt
Попробуйте: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. Сделайте вторую версию, убрав только percussion. Не используйте имена artists.

## Три cue-типа
Дайте пять секунд входа до первого стихотворения, очень тихий фон или silence под плотным текстом и короткий release после целого стихотворения. Репетируйте с настоящими микрофоном и залом. Если слово теряется сзади, музыка мешает.

## Идеи на сегодня
- Напишите ТИШИНА рядом с поворотом и концом.
- Оставьте cue длиннее для clean fade.
- Сделайте версию с одним инструментом меньше.
- Передайте timestamps, сигналы и owner изменений.

## FAQ
### Музыка нужна каждому стихотворению?
Нет. Контраст усиливает редкие cues.
### Под быстрый текст?
Только если слова ясны.
### Насколько громко?
Сводите с live voice.
### AI решает права или правила площадки?
Нет, подтвердите их с ответственными.

zh.title: 为 spoken-word 诗歌朗诵制作 AI 音乐 cue sheet
zh.description: 一套实用流程：为朗诵提供结构，但不盖住语言、呼吸和沉默。
body: 当音乐试图填满每一次停顿时，spoken-word 朗诵会失去中心。单独听来有吸引力的 pulse 可能抹平换行、遮住辅音，或在诗歌尚未赢得情绪之前替它下结论。更有用的问题不是哪首 track 适合诗，而是声音在哪里能帮助听众留在文字里。

## 什么是 EasyMusic.AI？
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/zh/ai-music-generator) 是一个可根据 prompts、lyrics 和 style direction 制作 music drafts 的平台。用于朗诵时，它可帮助测试稀疏的 instrumental textures；poet、performers、venue team 和 sound engineer 仍要作最终艺术与技术决定。[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/zh/tools/music-style-generator) 可把氛围笔记整理为 brief，[Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/zh/tools/audio-converter) 可准备 review file。

## 先做文字和呼吸地图
标出需要干净 silence 的句子、可用小入口重置注意力的位置，以及 applause 或 movement 的转场。姓名、直接引用、快速列表、多语言段落和每首诗最后一句通常属于第一类。background 不应让 speech 更难辨认；microphone 和 captions 不能代替清晰的 mix。

## 写克制的 prompt
可试：sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech。第二版只改一个元素，例如去掉 percussion。避免 artist names 和熟悉歌曲引用。

## 三种 cue
第一首诗前用五秒 arrival cue；文字密集处保持极低或 silence；一首完整诗结束后才用短 release。用真实 microphone、room 和 speaker position 排练，再从后排听。若丢失一个词，music 不是 atmosphere，而是 interference。

## 今晚即可使用
- 在每首诗的转折和结尾旁写下“静音”。
- 让一个 cue 比需要的更长，方便 clean fade。
- 做一版少一个 instrument 的版本。
- 交接 timestamps、start/stop signals 和可叫变更的人。

## FAQ
### 每首诗都需要 music 吗？
不需要。对比会让保留下来的少数 cues 更有意义。
### 快速诗句下能放 cue 吗？
仅当 words 仍轻松清楚。
### 多响合适？
没有通用数值；以现场 voice 为准。
### AI music 能解决 rights 或 venue requirements 吗？
不能；请和负责人确认。

ja.title: spoken-word poetry setのためのAI music cue sheetを作る

## EasyMusic.AIとは？
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ja/ai-music-generator) はprompts、lyrics、style directionからmusic draftsを作るプラットフォームです。朗読ではsparseなinstrumental texturesを試せますが、poet、performers、venue team、sound engineerが最終判断をします。[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/music-style-generator) はatmosphere noteをbriefにし、[Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/audio-converter) はreview fileを準備します。

## word-and-breath mapから始める
clean silence、注意を戻す小さなentry、applauseやmovementのtransitionを印します。names、direct quotes、fast lists、多言語passages、最後のlineはsilenceに置くことが多いです。backgroundはspeechを分かりにくくしてはいけません。microphoneやcaptionsはclear mixの代わりになりません。

## restraintをpromptする
例：sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech。percussionを外すなど一要素だけ変えた二案を作ります。artist namesは避けます。

## 三つのcue types
最初のpoem前に五秒のarrival cue、text-heavy passagesの下にはvery lowかsilence、完成したpoem後にだけshort releaseを使います。実際のmicrophoneとroomでrehearseします。後ろでwordを失うならmusicはinterferenceです。

## 今夜使える案
- turnとendingにSILENCEと書く。
- clean fade用にcueを少し長くする。
- instrumentを一つ減らしたversionを作る。
- timestamps、signals、changeを呼べるpersonを渡す。

## FAQ
### 全poemにmusicが必要？
不要です。contrastが少数のcueを意味深くします。
### fast poemの下でも？
wordsが明瞭ならのみです。
### どのくらいの音量？
live voiceに合わせてmixします。
### AI musicはrightsやvenue rulesを解決する？
いいえ。責任者に確認してください。

ko.title: spoken-word poetry set용 AI music cue sheet 만들기

clean silence, 작은 entries, applause나 movement transitions를 표시하세요. names, direct quotes, fast lists, multilingual passages, 마지막 line은 보통 silence에 둡니다. background가 speech를 덜 구별되게 해서는 안 됩니다. microphone과 captions은 clear mix를 대체하지 못합니다.

## restraint prompt
예: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. percussion을 빼는 등 하나만 바꾼 두 drafts를 만드세요. artist names는 피합니다.

## 세 cue types
첫 poem 전 five-second arrival cue, text-heavy passages 아래 very low 또는 silence, 완성된 poem 뒤에만 short release를 씁니다. 실제 microphone과 room에서 rehearse하세요. 뒤쪽에서 word가 사라지면 music은 interference입니다.

## 오늘 쓸 아이디어
- turn과 ending 옆에 SILENCE를 씁니다.
- clean fade를 위해 cue를 조금 길게 둡니다.
- instrument 하나를 뺀 version을 만듭니다.
- timestamps, signals, change를 부를 person을 넘깁니다.

## FAQ
### 모든 poem에 music이 필요한가요?
아니요. contrast가 적은 cues를 더 의미 있게 합니다.
### fast poem 아래도 가능한가요?
words가 선명할 때만입니다.
### 얼마나 크게?
live voice에 맞춰 mix합니다.
### AI music이 rights나 venue rules를 해결하나요?
아니요. 책임자에게 확인하세요.

body: يفقد عرض spoken-word مركزه حين تحاول music انقاذ كل pause. قد يسوي pulse جذاب وحده line break او يخفي consonant او يفرض شعورا قبل ان تستحقه القصيدة. السؤال المفيد ليس اي track يناسب القصيدة، بل اين يساعد sound الجمهور على البقاء مع words.

## ما هي EasyMusic.AI؟
[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ar/ai-music-generator) منصة لصنع music drafts من prompts وlyrics وstyle direction. في القراءة تساعد على اختبار instrumental textures متقشفة، لكن poet وperformers وvenue team وsound engineer يتخذون القرارات النهائية. يحول [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/music-style-generator) ملاحظة atmosphere الى brief، وقد يجهز [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/audio-converter) review file.

## ابدأ بخريطة words وbreath
علم clean silence وsmall entries وانتقالات applause او movement. names وdirect quotes وfast lists وmultilingual passages وlast line غالبا تحتاج silence. لا يجب ان تجعل background speech اقل تمييزا؛ microphone وcaptions لا يعوضان clear mix.

## prompt متحفظ
جرب: sparse warm instrumental, 68 BPM, soft felt piano and distant brushed percussion, no vocals, wide rests, no dramatic rise, gentle eight-bar edit points, room for close-miked speech. اصنع نسخة ثانية بتغيير percussion فقط. تجنب artist names.

## ثلاثة cue types
استخدم five-second arrival cue قبل اول poem، وvery low او silence تحت النص الكثيف، وshort release بعد poem كامل فقط. تدرب بالmicrophone والroom الحقيقيين. اذا ضاعت word في الخلف، فالموسيقى interference.

## افكار لليلة
- اكتب SILENCE قرب turn وending لكل poem.
- اترك cue اطول لclean fade.
- اصنع version بinstrument اقل.
- سلم timestamps وsignals والشخص المخول بالتغييرات.

## FAQ
### هل يحتاج كل poem الى music؟
لا. contrast يجعل cues القليلة اهم.
### تحت fast poem؟
فقط اذا بقيت words واضحة.
### كم يكون عاليا؟
امزجه مع live voice.
### هل تحل AI music rights او venue rules؟
لا؛ اكدها مع المسؤولين.
